sample_interval.description: Interval between DAMON sampling in microseconds (DAMON param: sampling_interval)

nr_regions.description: Maximum number of regions DAMON can monitor simultaneously (DAMON param: nr_regions)

output.description: Path to output file for `damo record` (DAMON record param: output path)

format.description: Record output format: 'raw' or 'json' (DAMON record param: format)

repeat.description: Number of times `damo monitor` repeats the monitoring cycle (DAMON monitor param: repeat)

interval.description: Interval between monitoring cycles in milliseconds for `damo monitor` (DAMON monitor param: interval)

reclaim.enabled.description: Whether DAMON_RECLAIM is enabled (DAMON reclaim param: enable)

reclaim.min_age.description: Minimum age (ms) of unused memory before DAMON_RECLAIM attempts reclaim (DAMON reclaim param: min_age)

reclaim.max_age.description: Maximum age (ms) before forced reclaim by DAMON_RECLAIM (DAMON reclaim param: max_age)

lru_sort.enabled.description: Whether DAMON_LRU_SORT is enabled (DAMON lru_sort param: enable)

lru_sort.min_free_ratio.description: Minimum free memory ratio (%) to trigger LRU sorting (DAMON lru_sort param: min_free_ratio)

features.schemes.description: Whether kernel supports operation schemes (reported by `damo features`)

features.init_regions.description: Whether kernel supports initializing regions (reported by `damo features`)

features.target_ids.description: Whether kernel supports per-target monitoring (reported by `damo features`)

diagnose.threshold.description: Threshold (ms) for detecting stale DAMON context (DAMON diagnose param: threshold)

diagnose.max_stale_cycles.description: Max number of stale cycles before DAMON context is considered malfunctioning (DAMON diagnose param: max_stale_cycles)

schemes.description: List of operation schemes (used by `damo schemes`, `damo tune`, `damo start`) — each scheme must have a `name` field and optional thresholds
